method: Every day the research agent reads each tracked developer page, fingerprints the text (SHA-256, sealed in Bitcoin with the daily seal) and, when the text changed, re-extracts what the page advertises. This file compares the values day by day and lists every change: the field, the old and new value, and the first and last day each value was seen. Prices are shown as a percentage change, converted to US dollars at a fixed rate, and moves under 1% are ignored as rounding. Permit numbers and deposit protection text are shown only as stated or not stated, because the text would identify the project. Values are read by an AI model from the page text, so a change can also be a reading difference: a value that flips back is marked as such. sha_from and sha_to are the first 16 characters of the page fingerprints before and after.
